_comment: PLACEHOLDER triggers. Each trigger fires once (unless `repeat`: true) when `when` is satisfied. Conditions: {event, subject?} (event has been recorded at least once; subject may end with * for prefix match), {flag, value?} (flag is set / equals value), {count, event, subject?, min}. `all`/`any` may nest. Effects: reveal (a hidden file path / contact id / bookmark id), set_flag {key, value}, deliver_message {chat, from, text, delayMs?}, unlock_contact {id}, log {text}.

deliver_message.text: [placeholder] hey. you opened the notes file, so I showed up.
